items.question: Can a UAE user switch their wallet back to a non-Dirham currency after converting it to Dirhams?
items.gold: No, once converted to Dirhams it cannot be switched back or changed to another currency.
items.fact: Dirham wallet conversion is irreversible, cannot switch back

items.question: What is the maximum wallet balance, in US dollars or equivalent, that can be converted to Dirhams?
items.fact: Wallet balance above $100 equivalent is forfeited during conversion
